entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello? I... I need to make a return, please.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Diana. I can certainly look into a return for you. Could you please provide me with your name and order number?
Yes, my name is Samuel Chen. The order number is VF88602. It's for the VeloBand Cadence Sensor. I... I just feel terrible, but I really need the money back right now.

Thank you, Samuel. I've pulled up your order. I see you received the VeloBand about 19 days ago. To make sure I understand the situation, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Oh no, it works perfectly fine. I just... I haven't even really used it. With the holidays just ending, things are tighter than I expected. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for a long time, and I was just hoping there was something you could do.

I understand completely, and I appreciate your loyalty with us. Let me check the specifics for you. I will say, our return policy can be strict on wearable items. Usually, for reasons of hygiene and public sanitation, it's often too late to accept a return after this much time has passed.
Oh. I was really hoping... that's really disappointing to hear.

Please hold on for just one moment while I review the full policy details for your specific product... Okay! Actually, I have some good news for you, Samuel. It looks like the VeloBand Cadence Sensor falls under our 90-day return window. So you are well within the timeframe for a full refund.
Really? Oh, thank goodness. That is such a relief. Thank you so much, Diana. You have no idea what a help that is.

Of course! I'm happy I could get this sorted out for you. I've just initiated the return in our system. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to the email address on file now. Just print it out, attach it to the original box, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive it, you can expect the refund to your original payment method within 3-5 business days.
That's perfect. I'll get that sent out today. Thank you again, I really appreciate it.
You are very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was everything. You've been a great help.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
